top_news.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
top_news.dek: OpenAI details the evolution of Habitat, its internal storage platform designed to handle millisecond-latency requirements for over 1 billion users.
top_news.brief: Habitat serves as the backbone for OpenAI's product suite, operating across 40 geographic regions. The platform's design philosophy prioritizes reliability for mission-critical traffic, followed by global performance optimization and operational scalability. The architecture leverages Azure Cosmos DB and multi-tenancy to maintain high developer velocity while supporting explosive growth.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the multi-layered architecture of the Habitat storage platform

top_news.title: Prediction Is Not Calibration: Item Parameter Recovery and Representation Coupling in Knowledge Tracing
top_news.dek: New research highlights that predictive accuracy in knowledge tracing models does not guarantee accurate recovery of underlying item parameters.
top_news.brief: The study examines how various decoders (2PL, GPCM, NRM) paired with encoders like Transformers and LSTMs handle parameter estimation. Findings indicate that affine logit identities allow item-dependent shifts to be absorbed into parameters without altering response probabilities, complicating the recovery of true item characteristics.
top_news.image_alt: Chart comparing predictive accuracy versus parameter recovery in knowledge tracing models

top_news.title: Orchestrating SageMaker AI endpoint auto scaling with AWS CDK
top_news.dek: A new AWS CDK construct automates the deregistration and re-registration of SageMaker auto-scaling targets during endpoint updates.
top_news.brief: Updating SageMaker real-time endpoints via CloudFormation or CDK often fails because the scalable target must be deregistered first. This solution uses custom resources to orchestrate the lifecycle of Application Auto Scaling, allowing developers to update instance configurations without manual intervention or deployment errors.
top_news.image_alt: Workflow diagram showing the CDK custom resource orchestrating SageMaker endpoint updates

top_news.title: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads
top_news.dek: Google updated its privacy policy to allow the use of personal data from Gmail, Drive, and Photos for targeted ads within AI features.
top_news.brief: An October 16th policy update removes previous restrictions on using personal user data for ad targeting. The change specifically impacts users interacting with personalized AI features, marking a shift in how Google leverages private user content for advertising revenue.
top_news.image_alt: Graphic representing data privacy and targeted advertising

top_news.title: AI: EU Member States approve “digital expropriation” of Europeans for AI companies
top_news.dek: EU member states have approved the 'Digital Omnibus' proposal, raising concerns over data protection standards for AI development.
top_news.brief: The proposal, passed via a fast-track procedure without a fundamental rights assessment, has been criticized by privacy advocates as a form of digital expropriation. Critics argue the move prioritizes AI industry profits over established European data protection rights.
top_news.image_alt: European Union flag and digital data icons
